title: Athothis
summary: King listed in CFAH-7B Table 6 (Egypt Dynasty 1 (Thinis)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 1 (Thinis). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7B (Table 6, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 1"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 2164 / 2163; Start Sole-rex: 2128; Death or Deposition: 2068
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 6 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 1", p. 92

reign.date: A. M. 2034, when Athothes, the second king of Thebes, died
reign.citation: Shuckford, The Sacred and Profane History of the World Connected, 5th ed., revised by James Creighton (London: William Baynes, 1819), vol. 1, Book V, p. 246 (facsimile PDF p. 342)
reign.note: The spelling on the page is Athothes. The existing person is Athothis, whom CFAH equates with Narmer. Shuckford does not say Narmer. See open question K7.
